title: Capacity to Ship Packages within D Days
pattern: BS on answer with greedy packing
problemStatement: Find the least ship capacity that delivers all packages, in order, within D days.
intuition: The range is bounded below by max(weight) (a package must fit) and above by sum(weights) (ship everything in one day). Greedy day-filling checks feasibility in O(n).

approaches.title: Optimal: binary search over capacity
approaches.idea: Greedy: keep loading until the next package overflows, then start a new day.
approaches.dryRun:
weights 1..10 D=5, range [10,55]
cap=32 -> 2 days feasible
cap=21 -> 3 days feasible
cap=15 -> 5 days feasible
cap=14 -> 6 days infeasible -> 15
approaches.whyWorks: Greedy filling minimises the day count for a fixed capacity, so it is an exact feasibility test.

commonMistakes: Starting the low bound at 1 instead of max(weights)
Off-by-one in the day counter (starting at 0)
patternRecognition: Identical to split-array-largest-sum, book allocation and painter partition
interviewInsight: Naming the four equivalent problems in one breath is a strong signal of pattern mastery.
